name: Tracing Trance
text:
Trigger Your turn begins.

---
Your hands flow unbidden, tracing runes as if by purest instinct. You become Quickened until the end of your turn and can use the extra action only to Trace a Rune (including to supply 1 action if using the 2-action version of Trace Rune). Focused on the act of creation, you can't use invocation actions this turn.
